prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: fully rendered desktop web game homepage, first viewport only, 1440x900 landscape.
Primary request: Produce one exceptional polished UNO game title screen called "The opening hand". This is a usable website UI, no browser chrome.
Input image: Use the attached screenshot only as the binding reference for the existing comic-card visual world and original character identities. Change the homepage composition completely to the structure below. Do not retain its giant cream outer poster.
Composition in order: 1) An ink-black #15151b full-viewport canvas with generous breathing room. Top left small cream UNO brand, top right a discreet cream gear icon and SETTINGS. 2) Centered above the controls, a compact confident cream UNO title in bold italic Barlow Condensed, around 100 pixels tall rather than a giant hero. Directly under it readable cream Outfit text "Your table. Your rules." 3) The central dominant interactive object is three large actual UNO playing cards fanned as a game menu. Warm cream thick native card rims, vivid flat faces, crisp white elliptical native UNO face shapes, shallow physical stock depth. Each is about 230px wide by 350px tall. Left red card tilted -13 degrees reads "CREATE A ROOM" on its exposed upper-middle area. Right blue card tilted +13 degrees reads "JOIN A ROOM". Foreground center yellow card raised slightly, with dark ink boldly legible "PLAY WITH BOTS" and a clear right arrow. Place all labels on readable open exposed areas, no overlapped words. The center yellow card is obviously the primary action and overlaps the inner edges of the other two cards. The cards are large touchable controls, not tiny decorative cards, not generic rounded rectangular buttons. 4) Two subdued but clear cream text controls below the card fan: "Set up bots" and "How to play", each with a small relevant outlined icon and adequate touch space, on one centered line. 5) Very low and quiet original comic cast from reference behind and below the fan, around the bottom corners: blue rabbit in red hoodie, red panda in yellow hoodie, green crocodile in blue hoodie. These figures recede in ink and scale so they are a companion backdrop rather than the dominant hero, leaving the actionable card faces completely clear. A small centered bottom line reads "No signup. Just one more round."
Style and medium: extremely high-fidelity production screenshot; comic ink native-card graphics, precise web typesetting, crisp vector-like edges, controlled original character line work. Barlow Condensed extra bold italic uppercase headlines and action lettering, Outfit for supporting labels. Ink-black, warm cream #fff4d6, card red #df0735, yellow #ffce00 and blue #075bee with restrained green details. A few extremely subtle hand-drawn edge marks can connect the composition, with no noise behind text.
Constraints: Keep all five actual actions and SETTINGS. Exact real product name UNO. No fabricated scores, player counts, stats, prices, claims, accounts, tabs, feature tiles or extra navigation. Full viewport layout, no giant cream outer panel, no gradient AI styling, no dashboard, no corporate landing page, no mockup device frame. Preserve the original character identities and native-card world, with the dramatic fan menu as the main experience. Render a finished UI people can immediately understand and play.
